setup.intentional_prior_state: user-only fixture with no credential/account row

error.message: CHECK constraint failed: ok = 1: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT (extended: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_CHECK)

scope_note: Provisioner-like CREATE uses a fresh UUID, so a preexisting user without a credential causes both INSERTs to no-op (email exists; new userId does not exist) and the postcondition CHECK fails rather than silently succeeding. The user-only row remains because it was an intentional prior committed setup, not a leftover from the failed batch.
